anomalies.expected: The LM1117 datasheet requires a minimum output capacitance of 10µF (typically tantalum) to ensure stability; 100nF is two orders of magnitude too small.
anomalies.impact: The 5V rail may oscillate or be unstable, causing the ATtiny microcontrollers (U1/U2) and other 5V logic to malfunction or reset.
